content: Only real Go IBus bindings: sarim/goibus (dead, 2018) and fork BambooEngine/goibus v0.0.0-20240724 (832 LOC, godbus v5.1.0). Powers ibus-bamboo v0.8.5 (Vietnamese IME, actively maintained 2026, Fedora-packaged by Red Hat's IBus maintainer) - production proof Go IBus engines work on modern distros. CRITICAL: neither repo has a LICENSE file, so cannot be imported into MIT-licensed goswitch; use as behavioral reference only and implement in-repo engine adapter. API surface needed: Factory CreateEngine, Engine ProcessKeyEvent/SetSurroundingText/FocusIn/Enable/Reset, signals CommitText/ForwardKeyEvent/UpdatePreeditText/DeleteSurroundingText/RequireSurroundingText.
